title: A/R Detail: exports list the ticked locations in A to Z order
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/R documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}, and you are enrolled at all three; in A to Z order {Location-A}'s name comes before {Location-C}'s.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310 and {Location-C} is another staging location whose name starts with a later letter.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with no location ticked in the Location filter ("Clear selection" clicked).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, tick {Location-C}.
  2. Tick {Location-A}.
  3. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Open the PDF and read the Locations line under its title.
  5. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  6. Open the CSV and read the Locations line at the top.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Location-C} is ticked; the chip reads "Location: " and {Location-C}'s name.
  • Step 2: {Location-A} is ticked as well; the chip reads "Location: 2 locations".
  • Step 3: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 4: it reads "Locations: " followed by {Location-A}'s name, a comma and a space, then {Location-C}'s name: the Location menu's A to Z order, not the order you ticked them; {Location-B} is not named.
  • Step 5: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 6: its Locations row reads the same: "Locations: ", {Location-A}'s name, a comma and a space, then {Location-C}'s name.

Where the build is expected to differ: the tech plan (21 Oct 2026) says selections keep the order they were ticked, which would list {Location-C} first. PRD version 9 (S3-R5, from Chris Ward's answer 7 of 23 Oct 2026) sets the Location menu's A to Z order with a comma and a space between names; the case follows the PRD. No ticket number is known yet. If the export lists the names in tick order, mark this test Failed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S3-R5: “Each export states the locations under the as-of line: "Locations: All locations" when every location is ticked, otherwise "Locations: " followed by the ticked locations' names in the Location menu's order (A to Z), separated by a comma and a space, for example "Locations: Main Shop, North Bay". Under it, only when set: "Past due: " and the ticked ranges in menu order (for example "Past due: 31-60 days, 91+ days"), then, for one ticked customer or vendor, "Customer: " or "Vendor: " and the name, and for several, "Customers: " or "Vendors: " and the names in the order they were ticked.”
  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D30, tick order: “Selections keep tick order end to end (chip state → URL → export params → resolve endpoint returns request order); only pastDue is normalized to menu order.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD and tech plan quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-the-native-location-menu.png: figure "The native Location menu" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p2-export-menu-pdf-and-csv.png: figure "Export menu: PDF and CSV" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"

The design's own words:

  • ""Select all" with "2 selected", every location in this report's own data named as in the top-right switcher, then "Clear selection". S5-R2, S5-R3, S5-R4, S5-R5, S5-R6." (caption of "The native Location menu")
  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")
  • "The native ⋯ Export menu on all six reports. Files hold exactly the rows on screen, in screen order, with the as-of date and locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor when chosen. S3-R1 to S3-R8, S3-R8a." (caption of "Export menu: PDF and CSV")

Design note (DR-03): the design shows with one name ticked the chip keeps its prefix: "Location: Staging Lethbri...", "Customer: 10 Trucking", "Customer: Andrews' Truck ...". Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R6 / S5-R13 say the chip shows "the name" and the chips are "exactly as on Sales By Customer"; the design shows how (prefix kept, shortened with "..."). Cases now say what the picture shows.
